scope: zero-API logical call planning before retrieval and generation

response.raw_session_unit: one complete strictly-prior same-user dialogue session
response.raw_context_policy: deterministic whole-session prefix fit under the same conservative provider-neutral bound used for QA
response.raw_top4_retriever: official-aligned BAAI/bge-m3 dense session retrieval; materialized only in E3
response.raw_strategy_policy: use the same frozen exact Rank-1 V4 strategy candidate only when structurally executable
response.raw_baseline_role: secondary representation baseline, not a legal 16-action PM arm

qa.model: same frozen meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct generator as response experiment
qa.context_policy: official-style leading context preservation, implemented as deterministic whole-fragment prefix fitting under the project's conservative provider-neutral token bound; finalized in E3
qa.official_session_rag: BAAI/bge-m3, one complete session per document, Top-4
qa.typed_memory_fixed_high: question-specific exact Rank-1 MP/MS/ME candidates that are structurally executable; RS structurally unavailable for factual QA
qa.typed_memory_learned_pm: the same frozen V5.2 MP/MS/ME heads projected on the question-specific candidate surface; RS structurally unavailable for factual QA
qa.gold_boundary: question is generator-visible; answer, evidence, capability and group labels are evaluator-only
qa.interpretation: memory retrieval and answer diagnostic; not response QRC and not an exact model reproduction of the paper

stage_boundary.e2: freeze logical calls, identities, conditions, seeds, user isolation and evaluator-only mapping
stage_boundary.e3: materialize retrieval, context fitting, exact messages, prompt hashes and conservative token bounds
stage_boundary.e4: the only paid generation stage; its new runner must require the active paid-run release guard
